description: This file defines interfaces and classes related to control management within the Rialto client component, including a factory for creating control instances and the Control class itself which manages control clients and interacts with a client controller.

classes.name: ControlFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of IControl.

classes.name: Control
classes.description: Implements the IControl interface, manages control clients, and interacts with the client controller.

methods.name: createControl
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to an IControl instance.

methods.name: createFactory
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to a ControlFactory instance.

methods.name: registerClient
methods.description: Registers a control client with the control instance, associating it with the application state.
